A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Mem-T research paper and complete Appendices A–C. Pages 2–26 have identical extracted text and rendered images; first-page differences are confined to author, affiliation, logo, and date information.

before.justification: v1 reports original Mem-T benchmark evaluations, ablations, sensitivity studies, and training curves in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original Mem-T experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including evaluations on four benchmarks.

M1.justification: The hierarchical memory architecture, MoT-GRPO retrieval optimization, hindsight credit assignment, and memory construction procedure in Section 3 remain identical. Appendix C's tool definitions and prompts are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use LoCoMo, LongMemEval, HotpotQA, and NarrativeQA with the same task coverage. Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within each corresponding experiment in Tables 2, 3, and 5. No evaluated baseline or GRPO comparison is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same evaluation metrics, LoCoMo 1:1:8 split, model configurations, training budgets, and retrieval settings. Experimental settings in Section 4.1 and Appendix A are identical.

E4.justification: Table 4's memory-module and optimization ablations, Figures 5 and 7's sensitivity studies, Figure 6's case study, and Appendix B.3's training analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Figure 5's shaded curves and Appendix B.3's reward smoothing. No seed counts, repeated-run details, interval definitions, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All result entries and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Mem-T's LoCoMo overall F1 remains 58.65 with Qwen3-4B in Table 2 and 58.53 with Qwen3-8B in Appendix Table 5.

T1.justification: Section 3's mathematical definitions, reward and advantage formulations, objectives, and hindsight credit equations remain identical. No mathematical reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about jointly optimizing memory construction and retrieval, densifying rewards, benchmark performance, and accuracy–efficiency tradeoffs.

C2.justification: Interpretations of generalization, memory-module importance, optimization effects, sensitivity, and case-study behavior remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Implementation frameworks, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and Appendix C's prompts are identical. The displayed code and model access links and their targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, comparison positioning, citations, and reference list remain identical. The author-list revision does not alter the paper's stated relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: The first page removes Guibin Zhang, the National University of Singapore affiliation, his email, and the equal-contribution notation. Affiliation numbering and dates are updated; scientific prose and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page header removes the National University of Singapore logo and shifts the Nanyang Technological University logo. Author and contact lines shorten; all research figures, tables, captions, and subsequent page layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: The revision is confined to author, affiliation, logo, and date information. Methods, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility details, and appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
